title: Phase change and formation enthalpy
hints: The gas is the reactant and the liquid is the product.
Subtract the gas value from the liquid value.
statement:
If $\Delta H_f^\circ$ of $\ce{H2O(l)}$ is more negative than that of $\ce{H2O(g)}$ at the same temperature, what follows?

[_]{a}

choices: $\Delta H_f^\circ$ of water is zero in both phases.
